response.sql: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), account_ratios AS (SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city), 0) AS town_transaction_share, 1.0 * transaction_count / NULLIF(AVG(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM account_counts) SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, town_transaction_share, ratio_to_average FROM account_ratios ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;
